work.englishTitle: MAXQ Special Edition + MAXQ Compilation Vol. 05: Choi Sohyeon
work.summary: Digital MAXQ compilation photobook featuring Choi Sohyeon, a Korean fitness model and Instagram influencer. RIDI identifies the exact 54-page PDF e-book, released 2024-09-30. Its description says it combines online-unreleased MAXQ Special Edition pictorials with MAXQ best and unpublished cuts. This numbered compilation is a distinct retailer product; overlap with Choi Sohyeon's Secret B and other MAXQ titles has not been checked. No ISBN is listed. Metadata only; no cover or paid e-book copied.

edition.contentSummary: RIDI lists <스페셜 에디션+맥스큐> 합본호 Vol.05: 최소현 as a 54-page PDF e-book published 2024-09-30 by MAXQ International; file size 11.3 MB. The description says it combines online-unreleased MAXQ Special Edition pictorials with MAXQ magazine best and unpublished cuts. Image overlap with Choi Sohyeon's other MAXQ and Secret B issues has not been checked. No ISBN is listed; no cover or paid file is copied.
